reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Namespaced composite resources: Crossplane v2 makes composite resources (XRs) namespaced by default", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: XRDs using the v2 API without an explicit scope default to Namespaced XRs, which keep Crossplane fields under spec.crossplane and do not support claims; v1 XRDs default to LegacyCluster and keep claims.
consequence.remediation: Set scope explicitly (Cluster or LegacyCluster) if cluster-scoped or claim-based XRs are needed.

proposed.statement: The v2 CompositeResourceDefinition API adds a spec.scope field that defaults to Namespaced, so XRs are namespaced by default (v1 XRDs default to LegacyCluster).
